title: Repair corrupt SQLite caches safely on Windows
description: A failed SQLite setup can leave the database handle open before quarantine, preventing Windows from renaming the damaged cache. Close unsuccessful connections and repair only corrupt databases; preserve genuine permission and lock errors.
why: Deliver the reviewed roadmap plan without regressions in existing project workflows.

acceptance.text: Corrupt cache is quarantined and rebuilt on Windows
Failed opens release handles and concurrent opens do not leak connections
Valid databases are not quarantined for unrelated errors

steps: Run the corrupt-cache semantic test on Windows
repro.expected: The damaged cache is renamed and rebuilt.
repro.actual: The open database handle prevents reliable repair.

outcome.summary: Closed failed SQLite initialization handles before quarantine; only corruption or obsolete schemas trigger recovery; concurrent opens share one initialization.
